correctnessFindings.assessment: The 10 MiB per-record allowance was already enforced for remote streamed transcripts. This PR newly applies it to local JSONL scanning, including byte-oriented consumers, before concatenation or parsing.

The resumable reader clones its cached fold, reports an incomplete read with session=null and the original start offset on failure, and rethrows. The parse cache is updated only after success, so a failed record does not advance the cached cursor.

The scanner catches the error and returns session=null plus a scan issue. Thus the affected session disappears from that scan, rather than merely dropping the oversized record or returning the previously cached session.

Appending more data does not remove the offending record: subsequent reads encounter it again from the prior cursor. Recovery requires removing, shrinking, or rewriting that record, or changing the acceptance policy.

originalReview.userVisibleBeforeAfter: A local AI Vault transcript containing a record over 10 MiB could previously be scanned. It now yields a scan issue and no session in that scan. Legitimate large image/tool payload records can trigger this behavior, and appending later normal records does not heal it.
originalReview.capacityAndDataLoss: New local 10 MiB JSONL record cap; exactly the allowance is accepted and greater records reject. The original file is not deleted, but its scanned session becomes unavailable. Remote enforcement remains unchanged.

platformEvidence.assessment: The byte limit and exception path use Node buffers and JavaScript on all desktop platforms. Fresh parser tests ran on macOS. Local file scanning on Linux/Windows and actual large multimodal sessions were not exercised here.
platformEvidence.executedHost: Fresh shared batch: macOS darwin arm64; Node 26.6.0. PRs outside that batch have no new execution in this follow-up.

originalReview.sshAndFolderCases: Remote streams retain their previous 10 MiB rule; local files now converge on that rule. This does not make a previously valid local record backward-compatible. No process liveness or Git-worktree assumption is added.

regressionCoverage.description: Fresh tests include session-scanner-jsonl-reader and session-scanner-record-budget. Exact-head caller review follows resumable reader failure, parse-cache commit, and scanner issue construction.

regressionCoverage.limitations: Reader controls alone do not prove good UI recovery. No automatic skip, durable large-record spool, prior-session fallback, or user repair flow is added. The cap is not justified as invisible merely because remote reading already had it.

originalReview.nextAction: Hold for a product decision on large local records. If the requirement is no new acceptance limit, redesign the scan path to avoid retaining large payloads while preserving valid records; do not describe this cap as a pure leak fix.
